title: , Wonderworkers of Chernihiv
name: Grand Prince Michael, and His Nobleman Theodore
Eustathius and Those with Him
troparia: (Tone 4) Having completed your life in martyrdom, you were adorned with wreaths of confession and swiftly went to heaven, O most wise Michael, with the good Theodore. Pray to Christ our God to preserve your native land in His great mercy.
kontakia: (Tone 8) Considering the earthly kingdom as naught, you left the passing glory and of your own calling you came to complete great deeds. You preached the Trinity to the impious tyrant, O passion-bearer Michael and the good Theodore. Now standing before the King of the heavenly hosts, pray that your native land be kept unharmed, and that we may always honour you.
